course.title: Turning Point Day
course.subtitle: One day, the first evidence.
course.description: Turn a single day into a real beginning in five short sessions: choose a direction, plan for the obstacle, take the first small step, and turn it into evidence over the next 7 days. Confidence grows from small proof like this.
course.outcome: An area you chose and your reason for it, an if–then plan, a first small step taken today, a prepared environment, one supporter, a written evidence note and a 7-day follow-up plan.

lessons.title: Morning · Direction: mark today as a beginning
lessons.goal: This morning, mark today as a fresh start and choose one area of life plus a reason that matters to you.

lessons.title: Midday · See the obstacle, build an if–then plan
lessons.goal: At midday, find a realistic inner obstacle for the area you chose this morning and write an if–then plan for it.

lessons.title: Afternoon · First evidence: confidence follows the step
lessons.goal: This afternoon, take a two-minute first step in the area you chose and record it as the first evidence for your confidence.

lessons.title: Late afternoon · Set up your space, tell one person
lessons.goal: In the late afternoon, make tomorrow’s step easier through your surroundings and tell one supportive person about your decision.

lessons.title: Night · Write down the evidence, prepare tomorrow
lessons.goal: At night, write down the day’s evidence, look kindly at what went wrong, and make tomorrow’s first step clear.

lessons.title: The next 7 days · Turn the beginning into evidence
lessons.goal: For the next 7 days, repeat the same small step daily, track it, return right away after a missed day, and look back on day 7.
